request.prompt: Stylised hand-painted game VFX with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background. A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a burst of golden light full of glowing hieroglyph-like glyph shapes. Frame 1: a soft gold glow at the centre. Frames 2 to 6: rings of glowing golden glyph symbols spin outward from the centre with a white-gold flash. Frames 7 to 11: the glyphs rise upward and scatter like sparks. Frames 12 to 16: everything fades softly until the last frame is nearly black. Gold, white and pale blue.
